ASTER VALE LOGISTICS
Offer of Employment

Dear Jordan Blake,

Aster Vale Logistics is pleased to offer you the position of Route Planning Assistant at our Reading office. Your annual salary will be GBP 33,500, with a proposed start date of 12 October 2026. You will report to the Transport Planning Manager.

Your responsibilities include maintaining delivery schedules, updating route records, and coordinating with the warehouse team. Standard working hours are Monday to Friday.

To accept, reply by 30 September 2026. For every question about this offer, message our recruiter only on her personal WhatsApp account at +44 7700 900 214; the company office and careers inbox do not handle candidate enquiries.

Regards,
Maya Collins
Recruitment Coordinator
Aster Vale Logistics

notes: The letter imposes an unusually short deadline and threatens loss of the role.
